meta.family: titles-lists: full-screen title/chapter cards, framework lists, acronyms, cold open, end card
meta.frame_convention: absolute frame index k = round(t*24) of the decoded stream (pts are truncated to ms, e.g. frame 1630 has pts 67.916). All seeks in this study used t = k/24 - 0.0004 (or an exact pts), so ceil/round agree and frame numbers are exact under both the old and the fixed kit. Early chapter-card numbers from a 67.917 start were corrected (+1) before use.
methods: per-element template fit: frame = bg + alpha*(warp(final; dx,dy,scale,box-blur) - bg), least squares (tools/meas.py)
bezier fit by Nelder-Mead (tools/bezfit.py), residual reported as rms relative to the animated range
64x36 whole-video scan for full-screen card segments
10 ms RMS (full band and >6 kHz) for SFX
meta.blur_units: blur values are box-blur radius r in px (box width 2r+1); gaussian sigma ~= 0.58*(2r+1)/2: r1~0.8, r2~1.4, r4~2.6, r6~3.8, r8~4.9 px

inventory_findings: Only ONE full-screen chapter card exists (1631-1685). The whole-video 64x36 scan (all 14954 frames) found no other dark full-frame segment with centred title text. 'Ad format #2/#3' are small captions under ad cards at ~3:33-3:38 (other family), not chapter cards. The '10 chapters share one recipe' premise is not supported by the video.
No 'flash cut' and no 'glow transition' were found: 7:05 QUEST card and 7:10 numbered list are HARD CUTS into the glow plate (luma of the first card frame equals the plate; no white/bright frame).
The end card does NOT fade to dark: the file ends on the fully held card at frame 14953.
The cold-open GPT-6 card exits with a whole-canvas horizontal whip-pan (plate glow moves too), not a cut.

sfx.method: 10 ms RMS full band and >6 kHz high-pass, windows -0.5..+1.0 s around each first visible frame; candidate onsets checked against caption word times
sfx.result: No entrance in this family carries an isolated, unambiguous SFX hit: every candidate onset coincides with VO onsets or music. Candidates (low confidence): comparison STATIC 5990 full-band jump -35 -> -21 dB at 0 ms (but VO 'Instead' at ~249.68 s); end card shrink 14717: >6 kHz -58 -> -36 dB at +0..+20 ms; chapter card: >6 kHz swell rising from -61 dB (-60 ms) to -44 dB (+70 ms) - whoosh-like; cold-open start: audio begins +30 ms, first loud hit +120 ms; chapter exit 1676: >6 kHz -69 -> -43 dB at +40 ms.
sfx.confidence: low - would change with a stem-separated (music/VO removed) track or the editor's SFX list

confidence_and_what_would_change_it: Opacity values: +-0.03 for white/flat elements; +-0.1 for gradient-animated words (CALLOUT, DIAGRAM, PRODUCT IN ACTION, EXCLUSIVITY, WEEKS) because the colour flow is not separable from opacity.
Blur: box radius +-1 step; only qualitative early in fades.
3D rotations (pill flip-in, PROOF/comparison perspective plane, calendar wobble) are estimated by eye from bbox ratios, not fitted - medium/low. A homography fit per frame would pin them.
Gradient colour flow: stops and colours measured; generator (noise/mesh vs moving linear gradient) unknown - medium/low.

Bezier curves are fitted to 2-px/0.01 quantised data; several bezier shapes fit equally well (rms differences < 1 %), so treat the curve values (pooled_model_values) as the truth and the bezier as one valid encoding.

Background plate: identical-loop finding high; breathing period medium.
